title: Large personal Amiga/ST/DOS engine and application-source discovery
summary: Personally screen 785 candidate URLs and add 14 projects, with ten explicit non-promotion decisions.
notes: Root personally searched 24 query routes, screened 785 unique URLs and inspected 24 pinned repository trees. Fourteen additions and ten explicit non-promotions; duplicates, framework-only projects, demoscene productions and instruction-level recompilation are distinguished from native recovered engines. No upstream game, compiler, installer, emulator or hardware program executed.

sources.reason: Disassembled and partly decompiled Logo with newer TOS, resolution and language-core fixes; inspected node allocator and 16-bit indexed pointer representation.
New jMonkeyEngine renderer/game reconstruction using faithful Java port and original Amiga assembly as references. Inspected level geometry scale and texture-coordinate reconstruction.

557 original functions reportedly translated to C. Inspected structured text-cache functions retaining original DS layouts, not a CPU instruction dispatcher. SDL2 platform services and Nuked-OPL3 audio model.
Native shared C++ engine uses OpenU5 browser behavior plus direct DOS analysis. Inspected source-address-cited NPC schedule logic; Original and Enhanced interfaces kept distinct.
Ports author-released DOS archiver source to POSIX and rewrites 80386 helpers in C. Inspected SAS 14-byte archive-piece header reconstruction with original SAS.EXE interoperability.
Structured JavaScript engine derived from ultimaVSDL decompiled C++ recovery. Inspected combat state/model and overlay-origin comments; original x86 is not the runtime engine.
Native structured subsystem recovery for English DOS V2.0; inspected finance/checksum code and original table extraction. Reads original EXE as data, not executed CPU code.
Original FOD/KEH disassembly plus C subsystem recovery. Inspected level map records and dirty-save function with original segment/address citations.
Original author reconstructs lost 1992 Turbo Basic source from executable/runtime operands and dumps. Frozen CA1.BAS claimed byte-identical, readable LEGIVEL.BAS and Python reference also supplied.
Browser game follows public-domain Delphi disassembly reconstruction and original assets. Inspected source-line-cited game script and original-format sprite/font/dictionary codec design.
Author-released historical 3D modelling application with Pascal/80386 assembly, UI, geometry and VGA code; inspected original basic3d records/lighting constants.
Substantial Pascal conversion from sjmelia/civd reverse-engineered C; inspected unit AI state initialization and original assembly helpers.
Measured LID archive, sprite, audio and Borland symbol-table formats with reproducing readers. Inspected22-byte directory schema and explicit leftover ledger.
Dual-edition Win32 native rules/controllers, original resource formats and overlay/CODE evidence. Inspected structured Checkers implementation citing DOS and Mac original coordinates and rules.
GitHub fork of tracked tetracorp/k240; inspected README retains upstream identity. No distinct independent recovery established.
Fork of sarnau Atari ST protection research, retaining same README identity; no separate source recovery established.
Fork of missingno7 recovery framework, not an additional historical game/application; no distinct recovery established.
Fork of pedrocatalao frontend/CRT presentation host; games live in separate native-port repositories. Not a new game reconstruction.
Experimental phase-zero reconstruction framework and synthetic horizontal-movement fixture, not a recovered historical game/application. Keep tooling outside this focused pass.

Primary runtime is whole-program instruction-to-Rust recompilation retaining original registers/segmented memory; first semantic replacement is asset decoder. Native machine code and no runtime decoder do not establish high-level recovered game engine.
Substantive Atari ST demo/intro conversion with bounded reference checks, but outside requested game/application focus; not a quality rejection.
Substantive Amiga demo conversion with CPU-routine/reference checks; demoscene production outside this focused game/application pass.
Relocatable Amiga demo rebuild and compatibility fixes, not game/application recovery for this pass. Retain for demoscene discovery.
Amiga intro disassembly and relocatable restoration with original bug fixes. Outside current game/application focus, not dismissed as binary-only.
